Endings 0/18

Newton's Laws cheat sheet

1st Law: Inertia
An object keeps its motion (or stays at rest) unless a net force acts on it. Net force = 0 means no change in velocity.
Clues: "keeps going," "stays put," "steady speed," "suddenly stops."
2nd Law: F = ma
Fnetm gives a. More net force means more acceleration. More mass means less.
Clues: "same force, different mass," "how fast it speeds up," "double the force."
3rd Law: Action-Reaction
Forces come in pairs: equal in size, opposite in direction, on DIFFERENT objects.
Clues: "pushes back," "A pushes B and B pushes A," "shoots out the back."
